first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon geometry for an Exeter important building, directly bound in the same feature to explicit building name/type-use evidence. The Ordnance Survey OS OpenMap Local Important Buildings public FeatureServer layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer and exposes DISTNAME, BUILDGTHEM and CLASSIFICA attributes; official OS documentation states OS OpenMap–Local contains important buildings and that its generalised building geometries are derived from OS MasterMap large-scale data. However, the distinct Exeter bbox first-50 record query could not be retrieved through the available web channel, and a direct no-login network attempt failed at DNS resolution before any feature payload or coordinates were read. No geometry or record was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
